topic: stop comparing yourself to highlight reels
lines: #You see the new car. Not the *loan.*
You see the holiday photos. Not the *credit card.*
You see the perfect body. Not the *lighting.*
Nobody posts the arguments. The *doubt.* The bills.
Behind on money. Behind on *life.* Behind on everything.
Even the people you envy are comparing themselves to *someone* else.
#But you're comparing real life to a *movie trailer.*
You, today. Versus you, a year *ago.*
Are you stronger? Smarter? A little more *disciplined?*
Put the phone down, and go build the life that doesn't need a *filter.*
#Your only competition is who you were *yesterday.*
end: Follow for your daily push at 7am & 7pm.
